purpose: Runtime bypass audit: every path that can construct a plan, update plan state, call the Broker, or enter an adapter without going through a future CP6 Evidence Guard. Read-only source analysis at base 09147b16a284fafa3ec922c6159ac4f2c26084c4. No runtime code changed.
method: rg over brain-server/src, desktop-daemon/src-tauri/src, shared/, mobile-app/src; manual review of contracts.ts, execution_broker/mod.rs, runner.rs, adapter.rs, bindings.rs, commands.rs, mcp/dispatch.ts, api/handlers.

classification_legend.SAFE_EXISTING_CONTRACT: surface exists and enforces a safe contract today; keep as is
classification_legend.NEEDS_CP6_INTEGRATION: surface is correct but must be wired through the CP6 Evidence Guard when the runtime lands
classification_legend.LEGACY_RISK: surface trusts caller-supplied fields that CP6 must re-validate or replace
classification_legend.POTENTIAL_GUARD_BYPASS: surface can forge or skip evidence qualification if the future integration accepts caller input
classification_legend.BLOCKS_CP6: missing runtime component that CP6 integration cannot land without
classification_legend.OUT_OF_SCOPE: deferred to a later checkpoint by design

key_distinction: validateExecutionPlanAgainstCapabilities() already performs policy-aware coverage contract validation for executable states (ready/executing). This audit does NOT report it as having no evidence gate. The CP6 question is who collects/qualifies/retrieves/clarifies/defers at runtime, and whether any other path can construct a valid-looking snapshot and feed it into a plan.

summary.critical_threat: FORGED COVERAGE SNAPSHOT: EvidenceCoverageEntry/Snapshot schemas are caller-constructible and carry no provider provenance; a caller can write status=present, verification_level=verified, evidence_ids=[fake]. Today no production path reaches Broker::execute, so nothing can exploit this yet. CP6 Integration MUST answer: executable-plan coverage snapshots come only from the Evidence Guard runtime; callers cannot self-fill them.
summary.coverage_provenance_gap: EvidenceCoverageEntry carries only evidence_ids; provider provenance is not embedded. CP6 Evidence Core must own qualified records and coverage must reference those IDs, with ExecutionPlan snapshot IDs traceable back to Guard/qualification output. Raw evidence must not be embedded in ExecutionPlan.
summary.no_production_bypass_found_today_caveat: Broker::execute is pub(crate) with no production caller, execute IPC is disabled, and no brain-server route writes plan state. The bypass risk is therefore latent: every surface above becomes live the moment CP6 wires a caller, which is why the Guard hook is required on each one.
